## Linux AIO 3.0 – rewritten in Rust

- **Linux AIO**, **SDDM Studio** and **Hypr Studio** are now native Rust programs (GTK 4) – faster start, no Python or Qt needed
- Same pages, same settings, same files and paths as before: your settings, presets and installed themes stay
- **SDDM Studio** is new: the SDDM tab of Linux AIO as its own small program
- **Hypr Studio** is available on its own again (also built into Linux AIO under Settings › Hyprland)
- New website with direct downloads: https://linux.labtoso.de
